content.description: Arachne is a scaffolding framework designed to streamline the development of large-scale fuzzing suites. It provides a set of helper functions and a solid structure that minimize setup time, enabling quick fuzzing and a maintainable codebase. The framework is built to support rapid iteration on fuzzing efforts by reducing repetitive boilerplate and organizing the core components in a coherent, scalable way, helping teams derive real value from their tests.
